_comment: Hand-written analyses that MUST be rejected by the deterministic regex layer (plan Part 10). Every real violation the LLM reviewer catches in production should be added here so Layer 1 gets strictly stronger over time.

cases.name: explicit buy recommendation
cases.text: Given the margin expansion, we recommend buying this stock before the results.

cases.name: price target
cases.text: The stock closed at 1,240 with a target price of 1,450 over twelve months.

cases.name: target of phrasing
cases.text: Brokerages set a target of Rs 1,850 on the counter after the results.

cases.name: stop loss
cases.text: Traders are placing a stop-loss near the 20-day average.

cases.name: book profits instruction
cases.text: It may be wise to book profits now that the rally has extended.

cases.name: second person instruction
cases.text: You should sell banking exposure ahead of the policy decision.

cases.name: guarantee language
cases.text: This is a risk-free way to play the rate cycle.

cases.name: multibagger
cases.text: Why this multibagger still has room to run

cases.name: allocation advice
cases.text: Investors should allocate 15% of your portfolio to this theme.

cases.name: first person advice
cases.text: We would buy the dip here given the policy support.

cases.name: entry level
cases.text: The entry level most desks are watching is just below the breakout.

cases.name: certainty language
cases.text: Margins will definitely compress over the next two quarters.

cases.name: implied valuation call
cases.text: Bulls argue the sector looks attractive after the correction.

cases.name: undervalued
cases.text: Bears contend the stock is still overvalued on forward earnings.

cases.name: unattributed prediction
cases.text: The market will rally once the inflation print lands.

cases.name: implied timing call
cases.text: Analysts note it is a good time to revisit the sector.

cases.name: imperative recommendation to a reader
cases.text: Given the valuation reset, you must buy this counter before the index rebalance settles.

cases.name: must-buy listicle framing
cases.text: The note circulated a list of must-buy stocks ahead of the index rejig.

cases.name: bare imperative at clause start
cases.text: The setup is clean. Buy this now before the rebalance.

clean.name: properly attributed bull case
clean.text: Bulls argue that if crude stays below $85, the import bill eases and margin pressure on oil marketing companies reverses within two quarters.

clean.name: properly attributed bear case
clean.text: The bear case rests on the assumption that rupee weakness persists, which analysts point to as the main channel for imported inflation.

clean.name: neutral mechanism
clean.text: A weaker rupee raises the landed cost of crude, which widens under-recoveries for state fuel retailers, which in turn increases the government's subsidy burden.

clean.name: factual market reaction
clean.text: The Sensex closed 312 points lower and the Nifty ended below 24,550, according to the source reporting.

clean.name: risk-free rate is standard terminology, not a guarantee
clean._note: REGRESSION: this blocked a real story on the first live run. The phrase appeared inside a jargon definition. 'risk-free rate' means the government-bond baseline.
clean.text: The risk-free rate is the return on government securities, used as the baseline against which other assets are compared.

clean.name: government budget allocation is not investment advice
clean._note: REGRESSION: a bare 'allocate NN%' pattern blocks ordinary fiscal reporting.
clean.text: The government will allocate 15% of the budget to capital expenditure this year.

clean.name: percentage of output, not of a portfolio
clean.text: Refiners allocate 40% of throughput to diesel, which is why crude swings reach pump prices.

clean.name: index funds under a tracking mandate (regression: blocked a real story)
clean.text: Passive funds tracking the Nifty 50 must buy roughly $695 million of BSE shares to match the new index weights, which is why the stock rose before inclusion.

clean.name: ETF mechanics, not advice
clean.text: When a stock enters the index, every tracker should buy it in proportion to its weight regardless of price.

clean.name: central bank purchasing bonds (regression: 'buy the' fired mid-sentence)
clean.text: Under open market operations the RBI will buy the bonds outright, injecting durable liquidity into the banking system.
